definitions.explanation: Something that is intended to last indefinitely or for a very long time, without change or end.

examples.japanese: {恒久|こうきゅう}⟦{平和|へいわ}→平和：01507_heiwa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{願|ねが}う→願う：02387_negau⟧。
⟦{恒久的|こうきゅうてき}→恒久的：06265_koukyuuteki⟧な⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。

⟦{応急処置|おうきゅうしょち}→応急処置：06519_oukyuushochi⟧⟦ではなく→ではなく：09578_dehanaku⟧、⟦{恒久的|こうきゅうてき}→恒久的：06265_koukyuuteki⟧な{制度改革|せいどかいかく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}わなければ→行う：01238_okonau⟧⟦{根本的|こんぽんてき}→根本的：17920_konponteki⟧な⟦{解決|かいけつ}→解決：00136_kaiketsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ならない→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Without permanent institutional reform rather than just stopgap measures, there will be no fundamental solution.

notes:
FORMATION: {恒|こう} (constant, always) + {久|きゅう} (long time). Both characters convey permanence.

USAGE: {恒久|こうきゅう} is a formal word commonly used in policy, diplomacy, and institutional contexts. The derived form ⟦{恒久的|こうきゅうてき}→恒久的：06265_koukyuuteki⟧ (permanent, as a na-adjective) is very common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {恒久|こうきゅう}⟦{平和|へいわ}→平和：01507_heiwa⟧: lasting/permanent peace
- ⟦{恒久的|こうきゅうてき}→恒久的：06265_koukyuuteki⟧な⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧: permanent measures
- ⟦{恒久的|こうきゅうてき}→恒久的：06265_koukyuuteki⟧な⟦{制度|せいど}→制度：03291_seido⟧: permanent system
- {恒久|こうきゅう}⟦{施設|しせつ}→施設：02503_shisetsu⟧: permanent facility

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {恒久|こうきゅう}: permanent, perpetual (formal, institutional)
- ⟦{永久|えいきゅう}→永久：01875_eikyuu⟧: permanent, eternal (broader usage)
- ⟦{永続|えいぞく}→永続：22835_eizoku⟧: perpetuity, continuation
- ⟦{暫定|ざんてい}→暫定：05626_zantei⟧: provisional, temporary (antonym)
